seo.metaTitle: Local SQL & table query runner — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Run relational SQL projections and filters over local CSV or JSON datasets in browser memory. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/sqlite-viewer-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Local SQL & table query runner processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/sqlite-viewer-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Local SQL & table query runner upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Local SQL & table query runner executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/sqlite-viewer-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Local SQL & table query runner upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Local SQL & table query runner executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/sqlite-viewer-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Local SQL & table query runner?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/sqlite_viewer.json or open /tools/sqlite-viewer?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
